t.E140.agn: In 2015 EFSA did not set an ADI because the data were insufficient; however, since the chlorophyll consumed from vegetables is much greater than that from the additive, it saw no safety concern at current use.
t.E140.body: Chlorophylls are poorly absorbed in humans.
t.E140.prod: Chlorophyll is obtained from plants by solvent extraction; chlorophyllin is produced by modifying this extract through chemical treatment (saponification).
t.E140.regx.0: No ADI set; no safety concern at current use.
t.E140.summary: Chlorophyll, the natural green pigment in green plants. It is used in green-coloured confectionery, ice cream and sauces.
